title: Pomegranate's beams (빨대)
body: +69% skill amp for 9 s to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power), never herself. Her level and ATK don't change it.

title: Beam count: 3 + 다발
body: 3 beams with no 다발, 5 with 다발 2 (Cheesecake or Herb), 6 with 다발 3 (Tiger Lily). Levels don't stack; nobody reports more than 6.

title: Who grants 다발 (Volley)
body: Cheesecake's orbiting letters, Herb's heal and Tiger Lily's mount, per the skill texts. Tiger Lily's reaches only allies near her.

title: The 다발 retry checklist
body: Pomegranate on 다발 2 by 45 s left and 다발 3 by 27 s left. Miss 다발 3 and the run stays on 5 beams.

title: Milk and the welfare perks
body: Milk must be ATK #1: 열정페이 (+20% ATK, −20% max HP) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) go to the highest-ATK ally. The HP cut kills her by 17 s.

title: Cheesecake's buff overrides Milk's
body: A cookie holding both keeps only Cheesecake's: 228K ATK vs 483K with Milk's alone. Best case: Cheesecake buffs Milk (667K).

title: Crit above 100%
body: Past 100% effective crit rate, +10% crit dmg beats +10% crit rate. The raid boss has no crit resistance.

title: Crit tiers
body: Crit rate past 100% rolls extra tiers: 200% always crits twice; 198% crits once plus 98% for a second. Each tier adds 50% + bonus crit dmg.

title: Skill haste formula
body: Cooldown = base × 100 / (100 + haste): 50 haste cuts 33%, not 50%. Only the parent skill's cooldown is hasted. No cap found.

title: Brightseeker haste breakpoint
body: Haste pays steeply to about 40, then stalls (model of a 43 s fight). Past about 58, her drones split onto adds.

title: Haste when the team dies at the slam
body: In a 30 s fight, skill amp beats haste: going from 20 to 40 haste loses about 3.4%.

title: Lift resistance
body: Airborne 0.4 s or more cancels a skill. Resistance: 20% base, 48% with Pinot, 64% with Pinot plus a 20% pet.

title: Lift resistance stacking
body: Stacks as base + extra − base×extra. Candy Shade Pouch gives up to 30% (plus 12.5% HP).

title: Skill amp nerf (8/27)
body: Skill amp no longer boosts stat-reduction debuffs (Dark Choco's too) or damage-reduction buffs; enemy DEF floors at 0. So Dark Choco runs haste.

title: Boss
body: 지나치게 무거워진 피냐타 is Dark, weak to Light (Brightseeker). Slam at 30 s elapsed; super-jump wipe at 17 s left. Accuracy, focus, crit resistance: useless here.

title: Octo Wasabi pet
body: +40% duration-synergy effect. +10% ATK to duration-synergy allies per the card; posters and a video guide measure +8% on Scorpion's entry (disputed).

title: Octo Wasabi's hidden ATK
body: The bonus isn't on the stat screen: add it by hand when tuning ATK order. It can reshuffle the order mid-fight.

title: Tea Knight is raid-only
body: Every 10 s: a 155.2% ATK strike and all allies +70% Boss DMG for 10 s (+45% at lowest grade). Guild Conquest only.

title: Tea Knight causes most stray beams
body: She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, so a beam jumps elsewhere.

title: Surviving the 17 s wipe
body: Floor: about 9M HP and 45% damage reduction per survivor. A 9.4M HP / 45.6% DR Brightseeker lived to about 9 s left on HP and DR pets.

title: Who still dies at the wipe
body: The ATK-order carries (about 5M HP) and Milk (열정페이's HP cut).

title: Survival and the Season 5 jump
body: At 21G account power, Macaron, Brightseeker, Pomegranate and Skating Queen dealt damage to 8 s left. Leading explanation for Season 5's jump, by timing only.

title: No manual control since 9/10
body: Removed on 9/10: placement comes from composition alone. So a Lv.1 Cherry is carried to push Brightseeker in front of Macaron.

title: Skill amp scales Milk's buff (8/13)
body: Since 8/13, skill amp scales Milk's ATK buff: why Milk is ATK #1 and leader in every top deck.

title: Weapon: crit rate or crit dmg
body: At equal skill amp, read crit rate after Macaron's buff: last two digits under 30, take crit dmg; 30+, crit rate. More skill amp beats both.

title: HP to survive the slam
body: About 3.5–4M HP survives the 30 s slam. Level barely matters: gear and lab HP research give even a Lv.1 cookie about 4M.

title: Sugar rune slots and rolls
body: Slots unlock at ★6, two at ★8, two at ★10. Line maxima: ATK% 7, crit rate 8, crit dmg 8, skill amp 5 (SSR), haste +5 (SSR; SR +3).

title: Gear enhancement
body: Sub-options jump at +5, +10, +15 and +20 (+130% at +15, +200% at +20). Only accessory groups roll haste: max +4.6 at +15.

title: Piñata's element
body: Dark: the boss's lobby screen shows the moon icon.

title: Piñata's weakness
body: Light: the boss's lobby screen marks the sun icon as its weakness (약점).

title: How a Piñata run is scored
body: Damage dealt before the 60 s timer ends. A wipe keeps what it dealt: one full wipe at the 30 s slam still scored over 100배.

title: Buffs scale with the caster's skill amp
body: buff = floor(base × value × (1 + skill amp ÷ 100)), with the caster's skill amp, not the receiver's. From Sugar Pocket's calculator code, not the client.

title: A share-of-stat buff scales with that stat
body: When a buff's value is a share of the caster's ATK or HP, that stat is the base, so it scales the buff too.

title: Debuff application chance
body: Chance = base × (caster focus ÷ target resist + focus% − resist%), clamped 0–100%; no resist counts as 1. No skill amp. Calculator code, not the client.

title: Piñata's English name
body: Extra-Stuffed Piñata, per the official English 8/27 notes and crumb.gg. One guide says Overly Heavy Pinata; the English client's data is unchecked.

title: Why fillers sit at Lv.1
body: Beams go to the highest-ATK allies (ATK, not power), so cookies that shouldn't take one stay low, under the recipients in ATK.

title: Scorpion, the tuned exception
body: Levelled to sit exactly 7th in ATK, so a stray beam lands on her, not on a filler.
